description: Indonesia coastal flood hazard is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Climate, Environment", published or maintained by World Bank Group (World Bank Group). Coastal flood inundation layers for Indonesia. The inundation estimates were computed using a GIS-based planar approach, which uses extreme water levels from the DIVA model and a Digital Elevation Model (DEM) as inputs. Extreme water levels and inundation extends are available for return periods of 10, 100 and 1000 years. Coverage: Indonesia. It has 6 files in TIFF. The portal files it under Climate, Environment. The portal gives 2021 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
